description: Predeclared fixed-budget replacement measurements for Figure fig:E6 and Table tbl:tableE6.

protocol.channel: BPSK, three-tap ISI h=[1.0,0.7,0.5]/||h||, AWGN second hop
protocol.evaluation: 100,000-bit blocks; means and t half-widths are across independently trained checkpoints

caveat: The 16 dB MLP total is 36 errors in 300 million bits. The across-checkpoint interval is descriptive; no iid-bit confidence interval is claimed. The 18 and 20 dB MLP historical rare-event values are intentionally not plotted.
